caption: Choose two Markdown notes.
eval: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['parallel-paragraph-reader']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openPair('Parallel Paragraph Reader/English.md','Parallel Paragraph Reader/French.md'); window.__pprPicker=p.chooseNotes();return 'ok'; })()

caption: Read English and French in shared rows.
eval: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['parallel-paragraph-reader']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openPair('Parallel Paragraph Reader/English.md','Parallel Paragraph Reader/French.md'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: An extra English paragraph has an empty French cell.
eval: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['parallel-paragraph-reader']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openPair('Parallel Paragraph Reader/English.md','Parallel Paragraph Reader/French.md'); const v=[...p.views].filter(v=>v.contentEl.isConnected).pop(); await v.selectRow(3); v.contentEl.querySelector('[data-row="3"]').scrollIntoView({block:'center'});return 'ok'; })()

caption: Each pair stacks in a narrow pane.
eval: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['parallel-paragraph-reader']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openPair('Parallel Paragraph Reader/English.md','Parallel Paragraph Reader/French.md'); const v=[...p.views].filter(v=>v.contentEl.isConnected).pop(); v.contentEl.style.width='360px'; v.contentEl.style.maxWidth='360px'; v.onResize();return 'ok'; })()

caption: Open the selected paragraph in its source note.
eval: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['parallel-paragraph-reader']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openPair('Parallel Paragraph Reader/English.md','Parallel Paragraph Reader/French.md'); const v=[...p.views].filter(v=>v.contentEl.isConnected).pop(); await v.openSource(v.left,v.leftBlocks[1],1);return 'ok'; })()

caption: Arabic and English keep their cell directions.
eval: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['parallel-paragraph-reader']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openPair('Parallel Paragraph Reader/Arabic.md','Parallel Paragraph Reader/English.md'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: HTML is visible as text in the reader.
eval: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['parallel-paragraph-reader']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openPair('Parallel Paragraph Reader/Literal.md','Parallel Paragraph Reader/French.md'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro saves a manual alignment map.
eval: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['parallel-paragraph-reader']; p.pro.signOut(); p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('parallel-paragraph-reader-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.openPair('Parallel Paragraph Reader/English.md','Parallel Paragraph Reader/French-gap.md'); const v=[...p.views].filter(v=>v.contentEl.isConnected).pop(); await v.saveAlignment([[0,0],[1,null],[2,1],[3,2]]);return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro restores the selected row for a pair.
eval: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['parallel-paragraph-reader']; p.pro.signOut(); p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('parallel-paragraph-reader-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.openPair('Parallel Paragraph Reader/English.md','Parallel Paragraph Reader/French-gap.md'); const v=[...p.views].filter(v=>v.contentEl.isConnected).pop(); await v.selectRow(2); await v.reload();return 'ok'; })()
